tools.name: search_jobs
tools.description: Search ~360,000 active US hospital/healthcare jobs (staff and permanent roles). Returns up to 20 matches with title, employer, location, the employer's posted pay when the posting lists it, and a link to the job page. Jobs with verified-working apply links rank first.

tools.name: search_travel_contracts
tools.description: Search ~57,000 active US travel nursing / allied health contracts with weekly pay. Highest-paying first. Links go to the contract page on Waypoint, which names the staffing agency and links to its posting.

tools.name: get_hospital_wages
tools.description: Hourly pay ranges (nursing, allied health, imaging, NP/PA) for a US hospital system from published hospital pay scales covering 394 US hospital systems (3,799 hospitals), last updated July 2026; NP/PA and some other figures are BLS-based estimates. Search by system name.
